# Crimes List ## Modifiers Modifiers adjust sentences up or down. Multiple modifiers may apply to a single charge.
## Infractions All of these crimes tend to be monetary punishments.
## Minor Crimes These crimes tend to be just brig time.
## Misdemeanors These crimes tend to include both fines and brig time.
## Felonies Crimes entail brig time and hefty fines.
## Capital Crimes These tend to use extreme punishments.
